class.name: OcgXscontrolTransferreader
class.brief_description: A TransferReader performs, manages, handles results of, transfers done when reading a file (i.e. from entities of an InterfaceModel, to objects for Imagine)
class.description: ! A TransferReader performs, manages, handles results of, ! transfers done when reading a file (i.e. from entities of an ! InterfaceModel, to objects for Imagine) ! ! Running is organised around basic tools : TransientProcess and ! its Actor, results are Binders and CheckIterators. It implies ! control by a Controller (which prepares the Actor as required) ! ! Getting results can be done directly on TransientProcess, but ! these are immediate "last produced" results. Each transfer of ! an entity gives a final result, but also possible intermediate ! data, and checks, which can be attached to sub-entities. ! ! Hence, final results (which intermediates and checks) are ! recorded as ResultFromModel and can be queried individually. ! ! Some more direct access are given for results which are ! Transient or Shapes

method.name: default
method.description: Creates a TransferReader, empty

method.name: SetController
method.description: Sets a Controller. It is required to generate the Actor. Elsewhere, the Actor must be provided directly

method.name: SetActor
method.description: Sets the Actor directly : this value will be used if the Controller is not set

method.name: Actor
method.description: Returns the Actor, determined by the Controller, or if this one is unknown, directly set. Once it has been defined, it can then be edited.

method.name: SetModel
method.description: Sets an InterfaceModel. This causes former results, computed from another one, to be lost (see also Clear)

method.name: SetGraph
method.description: Sets a Graph and its InterfaceModel (calls SetModel)

method.name: Model
method.description: Returns the currently set InterfaceModel

method.name: SetContext
method.description: Sets a Context : according to receiving appli, to be interpreted by the Actor

method.name: GetContext
method.description: Returns the Context attached to a name, if set and if it is Kind of the type, else a Null Handle Returns True if OK, False if no Context

method.name: SetFileName
method.description: Sets a new value for (loaded) file name

method.name: FileName
method.description: Returns actual value of file name

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears data, according mode : -1 all 0 nothing done +1 final results +2 working data (model, context, transfer process)

method.name: TransientProcess
method.description: Returns the currently used TransientProcess It is computed from the model by TransferReadRoots, or by BeginTransferRead

method.name: SetTransientProcess
method.description: Forces the TransientProcess Remark : it also changes the Model and the Actor, from those recorded in the new TransientProcess

method.name: RecordResult
method.description: Records a final result of transferring an entity This result is recorded as a ResultFromModel, taken from the TransientProcess Returns True if a result is available, False else

method.name: IsRecorded
method.description: Returns True if a final result is recorded for an entity Remark that it can bring no effective result if transfer has completely failed (FinalResult brings only fail messages ...)

method.name: HasResult
method.description: Returns True if a final result is recorded AND BRINGS AN EFFECTIVE RESULT (else, it brings only fail messages)

method.name: Skip
method.description: Note that an entity has been required for transfer but no result at all is available (typically : case not implemented) It is not an error, but it gives a specific status : Skipped Returns True if done, False if <ent> is not in starting model

method.name: IsSkipped
method.description: Returns True if an entity is noted as skipped

method.name: IsMarked
method.description: Returns True if an entity has been asked for transfert, hence it is marked, as : Recorded (a computation has ran, with or without an effective result), or Skipped (case ignored)

method.name: FinalResult
method.description: Returns the final result recorded for an entity, as such

method.name: FinalEntityLabel
method.description: Returns the label attached to an entity recorded for final, or an empty string if not recorded

method.name: FinalEntityNumber
method.description: Returns the number attached to the entity recorded for final, or zero if not recorded (looks in the ResultFromModel)

method.name: ResultFromNumber
method.description: Returns the final result recorded for a NUMBER of entity (internal use). Null if out of range

method.name: TransientResult
method.description: Returns the resulting object as a Transient Null Handle if no result or result not transient

method.name: ShapeResult
method.description: Returns the resulting object as a Shape Null Shape if no result or result not a shape

method.name: ClearResult
method.description: Clears recorded result for an entity, according mode <mode> = -1 : true, complete, clearing (erasing result) <mode> >= 0 : simple "stripping", see ResultFromModel, in particular, 0 for simple internal strip, 10 for all but final result, 11 for all : just label, status and filename are kept Returns True when done, False if nothing was to clear

method.name: EntityFromResult
method.description: Returns an entity from which a given result was produced. If <mode> = 0 (D), searches in last root transfers If <mode> = 1, searches in last (root & sub) transfers If <mode> = 2, searches in root recorded results If <mode> = 3, searches in all (root & sub) recordeds <res> can be, either a transient object (result itself) or a binder. For a binder of shape, calls EntityFromShapeResult Returns a Null Handle if <res> not recorded

method.name: EntityFromShapeResult
method.description: Returns an entity from which a given shape result was produced Returns a Null Handle if <res> not recorded or not a Shape

method.name: HasChecks
method.description: Returns True if an entity (with a final result) has checks : - failsonly = False : any kind of check message - failsonly = True : fails only Returns False if <ent> is not recorded

method.name: BeginTransfer
method.description: Defines a new TransferProcess for reading transfer Returns True if done, False if data are not properly defined (the Model, the Actor for Read)

method.name: Recognize
method.description: Tells if an entity is recognized as a valid candidate for Transfer. Calls method Recognize from the Actor (if known)

method.name: TransferOne
method.description: Commands the transfer on reading for an entity to data for Imagine, using the selected Actor for Read Returns count of transferred entities, ok or with fails (0/1) If <rec> is True (D), the result is recorded by RecordResult

method.name: TransferClear
method.description: Clears the results attached to an entity if <ents> equates the starting model, clears all results

method.name: PrintStats
method.description: Prints statistics on current Trace File, according <what> and <mode>. See PrintStatsProcess for details

method.name: PrintStatsProcess
method.description: This routines prints statistics about a TransientProcess It can be called, by a TransferReader, or isolately Prints are done on the default trace file <what> defines what kind of statistics are to be printed : 0 : basic figures 1 : root results 2 : all recorded (roots, intermediate, checked entities) 3 : abnormal records 4 : check messages (warnings and fails) 5 : fail messages
